messages:
maya: Quick sync — we need a concrete plan for the new inference dashboard metrics before the Dedicated rollout. Key asks from product: per-route latency p50/p95, per-model token costs, and traceable request -> span linkage for debugging. Can infra/runtime teams confirm what fields they can reliably emit?

jason: We can emit request_id and traceparent headers from the runtime. Runtime already stamps: `X-Request-ID` and W3C `traceparent`. We can also add `x-routing-policy` header (e.g., cost-tier=optim, latency-tier=fast).

ali: From infra side, we can ingest request_id and traceparent into our kafka topic. Question: do you want sampled spans only or lightweight request-level events (1 msg per request) with minimal tags? Sampling affects dashboard completeness.

maya: Need both: sampled spans for flamegraphs and full-request events (no spans) for aggregates and cost. Full events should include request_id, model_version, route, token_count, cost_estimate, routing_policy.

sam: Console UX/metrics team note — storing full events for 100% traffic will blow up storage. Can we agree on a 7-day hot index + rollup to 90d? Also need stable tag names for joins: `req_id`, `model`, `route`, `policy`.

elena: For oncall, we need preserved correlation when a request crosses services. Recommendation: runtime sets `X-Request-ID` if not present and preserves incoming `traceparent`. All downstream services should propagate both. Sampling must be deterministic on traceid for correlating spans to events.

jason: Implementation details: add small middleware to inject `X-Request-ID` and copy `traceparent`. We'll also emit a minimal event to metrics-kafka: `{ "req_id": "<uuid>", "trace_id": "<hex>", "route": "<route>", "model": "<model>@<ver>", "tokens": 42, "policy": "latency" }` — that's one-line JSON per request.

ali: Good. For the ingest pipeline, we can index `req_id` and `trace_id` as keywords. We can do 100% ingest for the hot index and sample 1% to long-term storage for per-request raw events. Rollups will emit p50/p95 per route/model every minute.

maya: That sampling plan sounds workable. Can we ensure span sampling ties to trace_id so that when a trace is sampled we can join the raw event by trace_id?

jason: Yes — we will use deterministic sampling: sample when `hash(trace_id) % 100 < S` where S is sample percentage. We'll include `sampled: true|false` in the request event. When sampled=true we also emit full spans to the tracing backend.

sam: UX note: in Console when users click a latency spike, they expect to open a trace view. So dashboard must surface a clickable `trace_id` when sampled. For unsampled requests we should still show `req_id` and allow linking to logs by req_id.

elena: Operational ask: add a metric `telemetry.ingest.lag` and `telemetry.index.rate` to ensure events are arriving. Also alert when `sampled:true` trace_count drops by >50% vs baseline.

jason: I'll open a runtime PR for the header middleware and event emitter. Pseudocode:\n```\n// middleware\nif (!req.headers['x-request-id']) req.headers['x-request-id'] = uuid()\ntraceparent = req.headers['traceparent'] || make_traceparent()\nreq.ctx.trace_id = parseTrace(traceparent)\nemitTelemetry({ req_id: req.headers['x-request-id'], trace_id: req.ctx.trace_id, route: routeName(req), model: cfg.model, tokens: estimateTokens(req), policy: req.headers['x-routing-policy'] || 'default', sampled: shouldSample(req.ctx.trace_id) })\n```\n
ali: For ingest, I'll add a schema with fields: `req_id`, `trace_id`, `route`, `model`, `tokens:int`, `policy`, `sampled:bool`, `ts`. We should version the schema v1.0 and include a header `x-telemetry-schema: 1.0`.

maya: Timeline: product wants dashboard MVP in 3 weeks for Hosted beta. Can runtime + infra deliver schema and a demo dataset in 2w so console can wire up visuals?

jason: I can land middleware + emitter with feature flag in 10 days.

ali: Ingest pipeline changes + hot index config in 8 days from now. Will provide sample dataset.

sam: Console will mock charts from sample dataset and iterate. Plan to ship clickable trace linking for sampled traces only in MVP.

elena: I'll add runbooks for debugging missing `req_id` propagation and alert run scope.

maya: Awesome. Action items: jason PR for middleware (assign to @jason), ali PR for ingest schema and index (assign to @ali), sam will create dashboard tickets (assign to @sam), elena will draft runbooks. I'll follow up with weekly sync. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: deploy queued: runtime/middleware/feature-flag -> staging at 1719001600

jason: FYI I'll include a small toggle in the flag to force `sampled=true` for a subset of requests to validate joins.

maya: Perfect — thanks everyone. We'll reconvene after staging validation.
